title: MBS Joins Trump-Led Multilateral Call with Muslim-Majority Leaders to Discuss Iran and Regional Developments
detail: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman joined a multilateral phone call convened by President Trump on May 24 involving leaders from Bahrain, Qatar, the UAE, Jordan, Egypt, Turkey, and Pakistan. The call focused on the latest regional developments — particularly the state of US–Iran negotiations and efforts to maintain a diplomatic track amid ongoing hostilities. Leaders expressed appreciation for Trump's commitment to consulting regional partners before major decisions, reflecting Saudi Arabia's sustained push for systematic consultation rights following the friction over Trump's unilateral 'Project Freedom' base access demands in May. The call came as multiple parties pressed for a broader ceasefire framework. The quadrilateral grouping of Egypt, Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia that has been coalescing as a de-escalation bloc since May appeared to have full US engagement through this format. MBS's participation signaled Saudi Arabia's role as an indispensable convening partner for any durable regional settlement.

media.caption: MBS joins Trump-led call with Muslim-majority leaders from Bahrain, Qatar, UAE, Jordan, Egypt, Turkey, and Pakistan on Iran and regional security
